Class SocketClientConnection

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.socket.server.SocketClientConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection, PersistentClientConnection, VirtualServerSocket, VirtualServer, Remote
public class SocketClientConnection extends Object implements VirtualServerSocket, PersistentClientConnection
Server-side "brain" representing a single connected client over a socket: it holds everything the server needs to talk to that client, namely the socket, the SocketClientListener (the "ear" that reads incoming data) and the SocketClientHandler (the "mouth" that writes outgoing data). Incoming commands are forwarded to the CommandReceiver; outgoing messages are delegated to the handler. There is one instance of this class per connected client.

    • SocketClientConnection

      public SocketClientConnection(UUID id, CommandReceiver commandReceiver, ConnectionHandler connectionHandler, Socket socket, BufferedReader in, PrintWriter out)
      Wires together the listener and handler over the already-opened streams.
      Parameters:
      id - the player's unique identifier
      commandReceiver - where incoming commands are forwarded (the server controller)
      connectionHandler - the registry the connection registers into
      socket - the underlying client socket
      in - the reader already used during the handshake
      out - the writer already used during the handshake
